description: This PHP class 'Smarty_Internal_Runtime_UpdateCache' contains methods related to cache validation, updating, sanitization, writing, and cache management in the Smarty templating engine.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Runtime_UpdateCache
classes.description: Class responsible for managing cache modification, updating, sanitization, and writing in the Smarty engine.

methods.name: cacheModifiedCheck
methods.description: Checks if the client-side cache has been modified.

methods.name: updateCache
methods.description: Re-renders and updates the cache when it is invalid.

methods.name: removeNoCacheHash
methods.description: Sanitizes content and removes no-cache hashes, reconciling cached and non-cached parts.

methods.name: writeCachedContent
methods.description: Writes the sanitized content to the cache resource if caching is enabled.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Saves the cache object to its handler.
